name: Andorhal militia post (market-gate post)
region: Andorhal, just inside the market gate on the left, past the granary lane

sensoryProfile.sight: A squat stone house, door open, lamp lit. One low room with a beaten earth floor. A canvas map of the granary district on the wall behind the table, chalked on and rubbed out so many times the streets have gone grey, with a line down Hurdle Lane worn pale. A stack of papers a hand high on the near table corner, furred with dust, held down by a river stone cracked clean across and fitted back together. A bench by the door and a bracket lamp over it in the street. An iron chalk holder on the table.
sensoryProfile.sound: Lamp hiss; later the shutter gap lets in night noises, cart wheels and the lamplighter's whistle.
sensoryProfile.smell: Lamp smoke hanging in a flat grey layer under the beams that stings the eyes; warm grain-sweet air through the shutter.
sensoryProfile.touch: Beaten earth under the staff heel; a stool Corin pulls out for Jaina; the table's edge where Havel sits.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: A harried captain's room: papers nobody reads, a map re-chalked many times, men sent out on the lanes at the bell.

establishedFacts.fact: The post is where the tally-man sent them. Havel keeps twelve men between this gate and Mill Lane; the night men go out at the Exchange bell and do not come back until it rings again.

Corin brings flagged-shipment notices here himself (an inspector must send a notice to the gate post); they pile up under the cracked river stone and Havel says he will 'get to it'. The top sheets of the pile are in Corin's hand.

The post's table is where the two halves are laid side by side (Corin's Heavy/Clean column, Sylvanas's lead sketch on the back of the folded south-road sheet) and where the capture is decided. Sylvanas's belt knife pins her sheet to the table.
The rendezvous was set at the post (Sylvanas: 'Back here. When the Exchange rings the night shift.'); the post is Havel's own ground, which the plan's guard against 'Havel's shelters' notes for Ch8.

eventsHere.event: Havel and Corin give the street truth and the paper truth; the split is decided at the bench outside.

The table: Jaina and Sylvanas lay their halves together; Havel proposes a dawn arrest; Corin argues speed; Sylvanas orders 'Tonight.'; Jaina offers the jaw plan; Cyndia, Lyriel and Corin placed; the candle pinched out.
